faq.q: How much does Kalikhman & Rayz charge?
faq.a: Kalikhman & Rayz publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Kalikhman & Rayz offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Kalikhman & Rayz publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Kalikhman & Rayz have offices?
faq.a: Kalikhman & Rayz publishes three offices, among them Huntingdon Valley and Philadelphia. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Kalikhman & Rayz?
faq.a: Kalikhman & Rayz names eight attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Pennsylvania does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.a: Kalikhman & Rayz scores 44 and sits at Verified. Passed: discipline, website and footprint. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and entity registration.
